description: This file defines the class cCgroupDobby, which manages container device cgroups and configuration for Linux control groups, including device permissions, memory, CPU, and GPU settings.

classes.name: cCgroupDobby
classes.description: Represents info for container device cgroups, handling creation of cgroup configurations and device permissions.

methods.name: createLxcConfDevicesCGroup
methods.description: Creates device cgroup configuration entries based on CGroupNode data, including device permissions and default device allowances.

methods.name: createCGroupConf
methods.description: Generates the overall cgroup configuration including memory, CPU, GPU, and device settings based on CGroupNode data.
